subject: Aurora Apps — request to pause LLM demo while team reprioritizes
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@auroraapps.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Aurora Apps — quick sync and demo options

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the intro last week — great to hear more about the product team's goals around conversational search. I'd like to lock in a short technical demo + Q&A to show how Redwood Inference can reduce per-query latency and keep unit cost under control for your expected traffic.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed 11/11, 10:00–10:45
- Wed 11/11, 15:00–15:45
- Thu 11/12, 11:00–11:45

Agenda (attached): 15–20m demo, 15–20m technical Q&A, 5–10m next steps / MAP.

If those don't work, suggest a couple options that fit your schedule. We can tailor the demo to the 3 use cases you mentioned (search, summarization, customer support).

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Exec, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
(415) 555-0183

Attachments: 20261110-auroraapps-demo-agenda.pdf

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@auroraapps.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 13:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aurora Apps — quick sync and demo options

Hi Naomi,

Appreciate the follow-up and the agenda. Unfortunately some internal changes just landed — the exec team has asked us to push the LLM/inference work out of the current sprint and focus on a platform stability launch next quarter. In short, the project is deprioritized for the remainder of the year.

Also, several of the folks I planned to include will be traveling next week (customer roadshow and end-of-year planning), so the dates you proposed won't work.

Can we pause the demo for now? Happy to revisit in early January once roadmap priorities settle. Please keep any materials you think would help us evaluate later (MMP, cost-sensitivity notes).

Sorry for the disruption — we'll reach back out when we have bandwidth.

—Jordan
Head of Product, Aurora Apps
On Tue, Nov 10, 2026 at 09:12 Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Jordan,
> 
> Thanks again for the intro last week — great to hear more about the product team's goals around conversational search. I'd like to lock in a short technical demo + Q&A to show how Redwood Inference can reduce per-query latency and keep unit cost under control for your expected traffic.

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@auroraapps.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aurora Apps — quick sync and demo options

Jordan,

Totally understand — thanks for the heads up. Sorry to hear the timing is bad right now, but keeping this lightweight while you reprioritize makes sense.

What I can do now:
- Share a one-page mutual action plan and a short cost/latency summary tailored to the three use cases (attached).
- Put you on a soft "check-in" cadence (I can reach back the week of Jan 4 to confirm next steps).
- Keep a single demo recording available for your team to watch asynchronously if that helps with travel constraints.

Would you prefer I reach out on Jan 4 or the second week of January? Also, is there anyone else on your side I should add to the thread so we can keep the MAP accurate?

I'll attach the MAP and a short note on performance knobs (batching, KV-prefix caching) that are often helpful for search workloads.

Thanks — Naomi

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_AUR_D-98721.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@auroraapps.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aurora Apps — quick sync and demo options

Jordan — quick note from me as Naomi's manager on this deal. Appreciate the transparency; we see this a lot around big launches. A couple small things we can offer while you deprioritize internally:

- A private demo recording and short technical appendix your engineers can review on their own timeline.
- One month of pilot credits if you decide to run a short POC within 90 days of re-engagement.
- We can keep the mutual action plan live and update it as your priorities shift.

If helpful, Naomi and I can follow up Jan 4 to gauge timing (or we can pencil a tentative window with no hard commitment). Want to make it as frictionless as possible for you to pick this back up.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

> Jordan,
> 
> Totally understand — thanks for the heads up. Sorry to hear the timing is bad right now, but keeping this lightweight while you reprioritize makes sense.

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@auroraapps.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aurora Apps — quick sync and demo options

Thanks Naomi and Marissa — that all sounds good. Please pause active scheduling for now and send over the MAP and the demo recording link we can share with the product engineers.

We'll aim to re-evaluate the initiative in the first two weeks of January; Jan 10–14 would likely be a good window to re-open scheduling on our side. I'll introduce a couple engineers then so we can get more technical.

Appreciate the flexibility and the offer of pilot credits — will be helpful when we circle back.

Best,
Jordan
Head of Product, Aurora Apps
